retiredWorkGroup.title: Training room booking
retiredWorkGroup.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — CEDAR MEETING CENTRE: ROOM GUIDE
All room rates cover one half-day, up to four hours. Wireless internet, a projector, and drinking water are included. Catering is charged separately. Rooms can be rearranged on request, except the fixed-seat Auditorium.

Willow: capacity 12; $160; ground floor; movable tables.
Birch: capacity 24; $240; first floor; movable tables.
Maple: capacity 36; $310; ground floor; movable tables.
Auditorium: capacity 60; $380; first floor; fixed theatre seating.

Ground-floor rooms have direct step-free access from the car park. The lift to the first floor will be out of service from April 8 through April 12. Reservations may be cancelled without charge until seven calendar days before the event. Later cancellation incurs the full room fee.

DOCUMENT 2 — EMAIL
To: Cedar Meeting Centre
From: Alex Moreno, Solis Training
Date: March 27
Subject: April 10 workshop

Please reserve a room for 20 participants from 9 a.m. to noon on April 10. We need to arrange tables into four small discussion groups. One participant uses a wheelchair, so step-free access is essential. Please choose the lowest-priced room that meets these requirements. We will bring our own refreshments and do not need catering. Could you confirm whether a projector is included? Our facilitator will arrive thirty minutes early; please let me know if that would affect the price.
retiredWorkGroup.passageZh:
文件一：Cedar 會議中心教室指南
費用以半日計，最多四小時，含無線網路、投影機及飲水。餐飲另計。除固定座位的禮堂外，可依需求重新配置。
Willow：十二人，$160，地面層，桌子可移動。
Birch：二十四人，$240，地面層的上一層，桌子可移動。
Maple：三十六人，$310，地面層，桌子可移動。
Auditorium：六十人，$380，地面層的上一層，固定式劇院座椅。
地面層的教室可從停車場直接進入，沿途沒有階梯。通往上一層的電梯自四月八日至十二日停用。至少提前七個日曆日取消預訂不收費；不足七天則收取全額場地費。

文件二：電子郵件
收件者：Cedar 會議中心
寄件者：Solis Training 的 Alex Moreno
日期：三月二十七日
主旨：四月十日工作坊
請預訂四月十日上午九點至中午十二點供二十人使用的教室。我們需將桌子分成四組討論。有一名參加者使用輪椅，無階梯動線不可少。請選符合條件的最低價教室。我們自備茶點，不需餐飲。請確認是否含投影機。帶領人員會提前三十分鐘到場，請告知是否影響價格。

priorDeployedQuestions.prompt: What is included in every room rate?
priorDeployedQuestions.promptZh: 每間教室費都包含什麼？

options.whyZh: Alex 自行安排帶領人員。
餐飲另計，非包含。
指南列明所有教室費含投影機。
只提停車場動線，未提供隔夜停車。

priorDeployedQuestions.explanationZh: 指南列明所有教室費含投影機。
priorDeployedQuestions.evidence: Wireless internet, a projector, and drinking water are included.

priorDeployedQuestions.prompt: Which room best meets Alex’s stated requirements?
priorDeployedQuestions.promptZh: 哪間最符合 Alex 所列條件？

options.whyZh: 只能容納十二人，不足二十人。
容量與桌子符合，但電梯停用，無法提供需要的無階梯動線。
座位固定且位於電梯停用的一樓。
底層無階梯、容納三十六人且桌子可移，是符合條件的最低價選擇。

priorDeployedQuestions.explanationZh: 底層無階梯、容納三十六人且桌子可移，是符合條件的最低價選擇。
priorDeployedQuestions.evidence: Maple: capacity 36; $310; ground floor; movable tables. / One participant uses a wheelchair.

priorDeployedQuestions.prompt: Why would Birch be unsuitable on April 10?
priorDeployedQuestions.promptZh: Birch 為何在四月十日不適合？

options.text: It is too small for 20 people
options.whyZh: 可容納二十四人。
Birch 桌子可移。

options.text: The lift serving its floor will not operate
options.zh: 通往該樓層的電梯將停用
options.whyZh: 活動日期在停用期間，與輪椅通行需求衝突。
每間都有投影機。

priorDeployedQuestions.explanationZh: 活動日期在停用期間，與輪椅通行需求衝突。
priorDeployedQuestions.evidence: The lift ... out of service from April 8 through April 12. / April 10 workshop

priorDeployedQuestions.prompt: What is the latest date for cancelling this event without a room charge?
priorDeployedQuestions.promptZh: 此次活動最晚哪天取消可免教室費？

options.whyZh: 四月十日往前七個日曆日為四月三日。
僅提前兩天，會收全額。
是寄信日期，不是最後取消期限。
當日取消已超過免費期限。

priorDeployedQuestions.explanationZh: 四月十日往前七個日曆日為四月三日。
priorDeployedQuestions.evidence: until seven calendar days before the event / April 10

priorDeployedQuestions.prompt: What does Alex ask the centre to clarify?

options.text: Whether refreshments may be purchased nearby
options.whyZh: 他說會自備，沒詢問購買地點。

options.text: Whether the event can be extended overnight
options.whyZh: 活動只到中午。

options.text: Whether early arrival changes the price
options.zh: 提早到場是否改變價格
options.whyZh: 最後一句詢問帶領人員提前半小時到場的費用影響。
